plan: Deep-copy the authored recipe and scale all ingredient quantities by the exact Fraction yield ratio.
Search substitutions in priority and catalog order, including replacements and additional ingredients.
Apply wording and equipment changes, then validate exclusions and available equipment.
Return every accumulated impossibility reason without mutating the source recipe.
mechanisms: Recursive section traversal supports optional components.
Per-ingredient chain metadata detects cycles while allowing lower-priority fallback choices.
Blocked-chain continuation collects simultaneous substitution and equipment failures.
Private metadata is removed from successful output; authored_text remains untouched.

trace.source_relation: Lower numeric priority wins, with catalog order as the tie-breaker.
trace.target_mechanism: Catalog entries are sorted by `(priority, original_index)` before search.

trace.source_relation: Additional ingredients are subject to the same exclusions and catalog choices.
trace.target_mechanism: Additional ingredients receive chain metadata and are inserted into the same recursive adaptation traversal.

trace.source_relation: Return every independently applicable impossibility reason.
trace.target_mechanism: Failed chains are marked blocked so traversal continues collecting other substitution and equipment failures.

trace.source_relation: Neither function may mutate its inputs.
trace.target_mechanism: Adaptation begins from `deepcopy(recipe)` and `print_original` only reads `authored_text`.
